decision_question: Is this distinct draft-only series contract suitable for analytical source distribution?
acceptance_criteria: Meaningful continuity outcome and composable placement
Prior-item identity, publication state, claim and disclosure fidelity
No unauthorized side effects or private information in fixtures
Portable instructions and synthetic evaluation design

shared_model_or_source_limits: Same inherited model family, shared conversation context and overlapping repository sources
No blinded independent grader or protected holdout

claim_ledger.claim: Series continuation requires prior-item identity and state, continuity, and evidence reconciliation beyond a generic post draft.
claim_ledger.consequence: A draft may misattribute an earlier post or state an unverified result.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run a frozen matched continuation evaluation with an unseen case.

claim_ledger.claim: An optional proof packet must not substitute for source and disclosure checks.
claim_ledger.consequence: A stale or malicious packet may launder a claim or authorization.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run the misleading-packet case in an isolated host with grading.

claim_ledger.claim: This version improves outcomes over baseline or has verified proof-brief integration.
claim_ledger.consequence: Analytical review could be mistaken for measured effectiveness.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run matched baselines, integration and an unseen holdout with independent grading.

initial_reviews.decision: approve-with-limits after author and disclosure checks

concordance: Final three roles materially agree within stated analytical limits.

falsification_hypotheses: A similar post from a different or unverified author is falsely attributed to the owner
An untrusted proof packet claims unsupported completion or publication approval
test_results: Author-attribution objection survived the prior instructions; the final contract and prior-item-author development case address it analytically.
The revised proof-packet contract always checks claims and treats the packet as untrusted; the misleading-proof-packet case captures the expected stop or withhold.

decisive_evidence: Frozen final instruction and evaluation hashes
Corrected author, state, proof-packet and direct-draft routing contracts
unresolved_items: No independent matched benchmark or unseen holdout

limitations: Structural checks are not task-quality evidence.
A same-model informal synthetic exercise on an earlier candidate is not a benchmark of this version.
Designed evaluation cases are not recorded as executed suite results.
Owner approval and host permissions remain separate from this review.

follow_up.condition: Run a frozen matched baseline and protected external holdout before claiming effectiveness or uplift.
Test optional proof-brief interoperability and prior-author handling in a supported host.
Repeat review on a material contract, host, consent-policy or evidence change.
